verdicts.evidence: `readFileSync(file, "")`: an empty encoding is treated as no encoding and returns a Buffer; `JSON.parse` coerces its argument to a string, which decodes the Buffer as UTF-8, the same text the "utf8" call returns. The file is written by scripts/rule-history.mjs as UTF-8 JSON. Measured 2026-09-25: the seven reader tests (valid shape, unknown version, non-object rules, missing rules, unreadable JSON, no package directory) give identical results under the mutant.
